absences: No vendor milestone dated after 2026-11-10 found for any vendor in scope. The newest dated vendor items in the searches were from October 2026, and skip/news.json already carries those.
eVinci: no post-August 2026 milestone found. Shipped Malmstrom 2030 target not changed by any source found. Shipped first_delivery_target is null, nothing newer to check it against.
General Atomics GA-TES: no construction or delivery date published after the 2026-08-26 Janus selection. Shipped 'Not published' still holds, so no check written.
Oklo Aurora: DOE PDSA and Groves criticality milestones confirmed in the shipped text. Only the startup target is outdated (see check). Oklo's Q3 EPS differs between sources (0.28 vs 0.22); not used.

Last Energy PWR-5: an October 2026 DSA report exists (already in news.json as last-energy-texas-dsa-approval-2026-10-08). No criticality or fuel-load date found; sources conflict on whether the DSA or only the PDSA is in hand.
Natura MSR-1: DOE's July 4, 2026 criticality goal is unconfirmed; no source found reporting criticality. Natura is not a shipped vendor row.
NANO KRONOS: NRC review schedule (final safety evaluation Sept 2027) is an NRC target, not a dated event after 11-10. ZEUS: no dated milestone found.
Deployable Energy: NRIC DOME selection (Sept-Oct 2026) and Utah MOU (Aug 2026) are already dated before 11-10; no later event found.
Blue Energy: Texas project is a 300 MW-class BWRX-300 plant, outside the 1-20 MWe scope; no microreactor milestone found.
Terra Innovatum SOLO: NRC safety evaluation was anticipated by Oct 2026; outcome not found in searches (newest item April 2026).
Steady Energy LDR-50: July 2026 STUK early review is pre-11-10; first-plant date given as 2029 in one source and 2030 in another, unresolved, not a dated post-11-10 event.
Skipped by rule: bwxt-banr, aalo-x, radiant, valar-ward250, antares (recently-checked list). Aalo and Valar were not searched for the same reason.

checks.evidence: MarketBeat transcript summary of Oklo's Q3 2026 earnings call (call of 2026-11-07; article dated 2026-11-07): the company's filing indicates the Aurora plant could come online in 2028 or 2029. The first full fuel assembly is targeted for 2027.
